summary: Iteration 7 — Verified two bug fixes: (1) Leaflet→Google Maps swap in /app/frontend/src/components/leaflet-map.ts, and (2) backgroundGeocode wired to useFocusEffect in /app/frontend/app/route.tsx. STATIC INSPECTION: leaflet-map.ts contains ZERO Leaflet library references (no leaflet.js/css, no L.map/L.tileLayer/L.marker/L.polyline/L.divIcon — only the file name and a comment saying 'NOT Leaflet' remain). It correctly uses new google.maps.Map, new google.maps.Marker, new google.maps.Polyline, reads process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY at build time, and loads Google JS API via https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=${apiKey}&callback=__initMap&language=pt-BR&region=BR&loading=async. Function name buildLeafletHTML preserved for backward compat (3 refs in bundle). ENV: /app/frontend/.env contains EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=AIzaSyA2X_t18zIuDrpAXpJvEOzDmOVVBsjf0qM matching backend. METRO BUNDLE VERIFICATION: fetched /node_modules/expo-router/entry.bundle from localhost:3000 (8.06 MB), grep confirms (a) the API key literal 'AIzaSyA2X_t18zIuDrpAXpJvEOzDmOVVBsjf0qM' appears in the process.env polyfill (EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY enumerable value), (b) the Google Maps script URL template is embedded, (c) zero unpkg.com/leaflet or leaflet.css/js references remain. ROUTE.TSX VERIFICATION: backgroundGeocode is defined at line 52 (useCallback) BEFORE useFocusEffect at line 88 — no TDZ risk. useFocusEffect callback calls setStops(data) then computes missingIndices for stops with lat==null||lon==null and invokes backgroundGeocode(data, missingIndices) when >0 missing. The useCallback dependency array correctly includes [router, backgroundGeocode]. BACKEND REGRESSION: /api/geocode-batch POST with two SP addresses returns 200 with {results:[{found,lat,lon},...]}; at least one resolves within São Paulo bounds. Empty [] payload returns []. 2/2 pytest PASS. FRONTEND SMOKE: mobile viewport (375x667) loaded http://localhost:3000, landing page 'Rota+Rápida App' renders with 'Mapa + Otimização' card and 'Entrar com Google' CTA, #root has 5837 chars HTML, zero pageerrors, zero red-screen. Only warning is the pre-existing 'shadow* deprecated, use boxShadow' from React Native Web — unrelated to this iteration. Expo SDK drift (expo@54.0.34 vs ~54.0.35, expo-font@14.0.11, expo-router@6.0.23) is a carry-over from iterations 2-6, still non-blocking. All 5 checklist items verified working.

leaflet-map.ts:174-175 — Uses async defer loading=async on the Google Maps script; callback=__initMap wires up correctly.

route.tsx:52-85 — backgroundGeocode wrapped in useCallback with empty deps ([]) is safe because it calls only stable imports (geocodeBatch, saveRoute, Alert). setGeoProgress/setStops setters are stable. TDZ safe (defined before consumer).

route.tsx:88-112 — useFocusEffect correctly: (a) loads route, (b) redirects to /upload if empty, (c) setStops(data), (d) filters missing lat/lon indices, (e) invokes backgroundGeocode ONLY when >0 missing. Cleanup sets active=false to avoid state updates on unmounted screen. Deps [router, backgroundGeocode] correct.
route.tsx:66 — Correctly leaves lat/lon = null on geocoding failure (no fake coords), so UI shows the '📍 Sem localização — toque ✏️ para corrigir' warning on the stop row. Good UX.

SECURITY — EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY is bundled into the client JS as expected (any EXPO_PUBLIC_* var is public). Same key is also in backend .env for server-side Directions/Geocoding. Recommend restricting the key in Google Cloud Console to HTTP referrer of the preview domain + specific API surfaces (Maps JavaScript API, Directions, Geocoding).

rca_of_issue: N/A — bug fixes verified. Prior iteration: (1) map used Leaflet CDN which caused rendering issues in the WebView, now swapped to Google Maps JS API; (2) backgroundGeocode was defined but never invoked, so any stop lacking coords never got geocoded → no markers on map. Fix: useFocusEffect now filters stops with null lat/lon and calls backgroundGeocode with the missing indices, which POSTs to /api/geocode-batch and merges results back into state + persistent storage.
